title: Pan-Seared Hake with Australian Flambé Sauce
description: A French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared hake served with a spicy Australian flambé sauce, made with energizing ingredients.
instructions: 1. Season the hake fillets with salt, pepper, and a pinch of energizing chili flakes.
2. In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
3. Add the hake fillets and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
4. Remove the hake from the skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and the chopped Australian bush tomato.
6. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the tomato is softened and fragrant.
7. Stir in the flambé sauce and bring to a simmer.
8. Return the hake to the skillet and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
9. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
